name: POST /api/leadflow/meetings/:id/no-show - mark it once, and open the rescue
description:
Marks a no-show, suppresses the stale reminders and opens the rescue with a 24-hour rebook task.

IDEMPOTENT BY CONSTRAINT (11672578-09c5-47e1-ae2b-47af58e6f038#AC4). The scan runs on a timer, and two no-shows for one meeting would double-count the occurrence and push a first-time no-show straight to manager review. MEASURED LIVE: the second call returned already_marked true with occurrence unchanged at 1.

A SECOND NO-SHOW FLAGS MANAGER REVIEW (11672578-09c5-47e1-ae2b-47af58e6f038#AC2), counted per CONTACT rather than per meeting - the rule is about the person, and counting per meeting would never reach two. A second miss is a different conversation and a different commitment strategy, not another automated rebook.

THE RESCUE IS NOT SENT HERE. The response states the rule: the rep must call once within five minutes before any rescue message is permitted, and POST /rescue refuses until that attempt is logged. QA: depends on register, login and POST /api/leadflow/meetings, which produces the meeting this marks. The happy path was added when a route-versus-definition audit found /:id/rescue-call had no definition and no producer: this file previously tested only the 404 and the two 401s, so the endpoint it names was untested rather than untestable.
